videos.script: Lesson 20 ended on a sarcastic review. The prompt named sarcasm, and the label still came back wrong. {{sarcasm}} Some boundaries are easier to show than to describe. {{show}} One-shot prompting puts one solved example in the prompt. Few-shot puts several. {{shots}} A model continues the pattern of the text in front of it. Give it three questions with answers, and the fourth is answered in the same shape. {{pattern}} You will watch that happen in the smallest model there is, and see exactly where it stops working. {{toy}} Then the harder part: choosing the examples. {{choose}} They should cover every label, include a hard case, and never come from your test set. {{rules}} And they are not free. Every example is sent with every request, and you can count what it costs. {{cost}}
